input.claim: Dropout reduces overfitting by randomly zeroing units during training.
input.citation: Srivastava et al., 2014, 'Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting'
input.source_excerpt: The key idea is to randomly drop units (along with their connections) from the neural network during training. This prevents units from co-adapting too much and significantly reduces overfitting.
